name: palforge
description: Content framework for single-player Palworld (UE4SS Lua mod). PalForge itself is the Lua tree under Scripts/; this package.json is the task runner for it and for the docs site.

scripts.test: cd Scripts && lua5.4 -e 'package.path="./?.lua;./?/init.lua;"..package.path local env=require("palforge.env") env.dev=true env.debug=true local r=require("palforge.test").run() if r.failed > 0 then os.exit(1) end'
scripts.types:check: t=$(mktemp -d) && cp -r Scripts "$t/Scripts" && lua5.4 tools/gen-types.lua "$t/" && diff -u Scripts/palforge/types.lua "$t/Scripts/palforge/types.lua" && rm -rf "$t" || { echo 'types.lua is stale — run: npm run types:gen'; exit 1; }
scripts.check: npm run lint:lua && npm test && npm run types:check && npm run lint:docs
